subject: Security checkpoint: MAP — SOC 2 package owners & due dates
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@novabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security checkpoint: MAP — SOC 2 package owners & due dates

Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier. Per our discovery call I promised a concise MAP update focused on the security milestone (SOC 2 package + questionnaire/evidence). Below is a proposed split of owners, dependencies we called out, and a target delivery window. Please review and let me know if anything is off.

Proposed MAP security milestone (summary)
- Objective: Complete security intake and deliver SOC 2 evidence package sufficient for NovaBank internal review and external auditor access.
- Target close date for this milestone: 2027-05-28 (aiming to keep your target Q2 procurement timeline intact)

Owners (Redwood / NovaBank)
- Redwood technical owner: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.com) — will assemble architecture diagram, provide log retention details, and share access notes for the auditor.
- Redwood delivery lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — will coordinate evidence collection and signoff.
- NovaBank security lead: Thomas Li (t.li@novabank.com) — will confirm evidence sufficiency and provide auditor contact.

Key deliverables & suggested due dates
1) Completed SOC 2 questionnaire (NovaBank to return with comments) — received draft on call; target: 2027-05-06.
2) Evidence index (spreadsheet listing artifacts + owner + access method) — Redwood to produce initial index: 2027-05-10.
3) Architecture diagram & network boundary statement — Redwood (Dev): 2027-05-12.
4) Sample logs & retention proof (s3 access / retention policy snippet) — Redwood to stage samples by 2027-05-18.
5) Auditor access window & handoff notes — coordinate between NovaBank and auditor: target 2027-05-24.

Dependencies / blockers
- We will need a point of contact for the NovaBank auditor and an SSO test account (read-only) for sample verification.
- Any restricted data policies / redaction requirements we should know about before sharing samples.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft.pdf (MAP with milestones), evidence_index_template.xlsx (blank index)

Next steps
- Alice: confirm Thomas as security approver and confirm auditor contact (if available) by EOD 2027-05-04.
- Marissa/Dev: prepare index + architecture stub and share by the dates above.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if that helps.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@novabank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Thomas Li <t.li@novabank.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security checkpoint: MAP — SOC 2 package owners & due dates

Jordan — thanks for the recap and the clear timeline. Quick answers inline:

- Thomas is confirmed as our security approver and primary reviewer for evidence. He is cc'd.
- Our contracted auditor is RiskAssure (auditor@riskassure.com). I will introduce you to them after we review the questionnaire.
- We will return the completed SOC 2 questionnaire by 2027-05-06 as proposed. If we need clarification, we'll add comments in the doc.

A couple of constraints to call out from our side:
1) Sample data access has to go through our security operations team; they prefer a signed non-prod access addendum and an IP allowlist. We can start that process once we have the evidence index.
2) Financial-data artifacts are not shareable outside of our environment — if the questionnaire requests transaction logs, we'll provide redacted samples and a redaction log.

Attachments: NovaBank_SOC2_Questionnaire_v2.docx (filled by NovaBank, will return by 05/06)

I'll loop in our procurement contact if any contract redlines appear from the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Procurement Manager | NovaBank
alice.moreno@novabank.com | +1 617-555-2268

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 09:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great to meet earlier...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@novabank.com>, Thomas Li <t.li@novabank.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security checkpoint: MAP — SOC 2 package owners & due dates

Adding owners and concrete tasks here — I will be the delivery coordinator and track signoffs in the MAP. Dev, please confirm the ETA for each artifact below and call out anything you can't produce without access.

Action table (owner / artifact / due)
- Dev Patel / evidence_index_template.xlsx (initial populated index with artifact location + access method) / 2027-05-10
- Dev Patel / Redwood environment architecture diagram (high-level, network boundaries) / 2027-05-12
- Dev Patel / sample logs (anonymized / redacted as required) / 2027-05-18
- Marissa Cole / MAP signoff tracker & delivery notes (Redwood_MAP_draft.pdf updated) / 2027-05-13
- Marissa Cole / NDA/access addendum template (for auditor access) / 2027-05-06

Notes:
- Dev: for the sample logs I will flag which datasets NovaBank has already said are restricted; we will only stage redacted samples initially. If they approve a broader window, we'll expand.
- Alice/Thomas: please confirm the IP allowlist range and any preferred SSO provider for the auditor so Dev can prepare the temporary test account.

Attachments: evidence_index_template.xlsx (populated draft will be posted to the Drive link)

I'll push these items to the MAP in HubSpot and add due-date reminders. If we all agree on the timeline, I'll schedule a short checkpoint for 2027-05-17 to review the index and logs before auditor handoff.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Delivery | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@novabank.com>, Thomas Li <t.li@novabank.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security checkpoint: MAP — SOC 2 package owners & due dates

Thanks — confirmed on my side. Quick status and asks:

Status
- I'll upload the initial evidence index to the Drive link by 2027-05-10 (columns: artifact id, description, path, access method, redaction flag, contact).
- Architecture diagram draft will be posted by 2027-05-12. It will include component boundaries, third-party services, and KV cache/storage notes.
- I'll prepare a small bundle of redacted log samples and retention policy snippets by 2027-05-18.

Open items / help needed
- Alice/Thomas: IP allowlist ranges + preferred SSO provider for auditor test account. If you can email those to me, I can provision a read-only account and document the auth flow.
- Alice: where would you like the NDA/access addendum signed? If you want Redwood to route a DocuSign link, we can send one the same day you confirm.

I agree with a checkpoint on 2027-05-17 — I'll add the calendar invite once Marissa posts the MAP in HubSpot.

—
Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Product Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
